subject: MAP: verification codex & acceptance signal playbook
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@novalabs.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP kickoff — quick alignment on signals

Jonas — thanks again for the demo last week. Our evaluation committee asked for a tidy MAP that makes it explicit which signals will be used to decide go/no-go and who owns each test. Can you send a proposal that shows: primary acceptance signals (perf, latency, throughput), pass/fail thresholds, minimal evidence artifacts, and a proposed close date for the pilot?

We're targeting an internal decision on 2028-12-07, so if we can lock the MAP and test owners this week that would help. Attaching our high-level business goals as context.

— Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of ML Ops, Novalabs

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novalabs.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 13:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — quick alignment on signals

On Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:12:00 +0000 Marta Ruiz <marta@novalabs.ai> wrote:
> Jonas — thanks again for the demo last week. Our evaluation committee asked for a tidy MAP that makes it explicit which signals will be used to decide go/no-go and who owns each test.

Thanks Marta — attaching a first-pass MAP and a short test-case CSV. See attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with timeline & owners) and eval-testcases.csv (concrete smoke and load cases). High level summary below.

Proposed acceptance signal categories (short):
- Safety/Conformance: no high-severity safety regressions on the sample prompt set (threshold: 0 high-sev / 1 medium per 1k queries). Evidence: safety review log + sample transcripts.
- Latency SLA: P95 inference latency <= 220ms end-to-end for 512-token average requests under 20 RPS sustained (evidence: perf trace + request-level timing).
- Throughput: Service sustains 15 RPS with <= 2% error rate across 1-hour load window (evidence: load-run metrics).
- Quality/Accuracy: task-level F1 >= 0.78 on the curated eval set and no more than 5% degradation versus our baseline on critical intents (evidence: evaluation notebook + diffs).

Exit gates (what must be green to commit):
1) Security questionnaire (SOC2 attestation or equivalent evidence provided).
2) KPIs above met in two independent runs (one warm, one cold) with artifacts uploaded.
3) Implementation of at least one rollback/fallback policy (automated fallback to smaller model variant if P95 > 300ms).
4) Agreed cutover checklist and owner signoffs in the MAP spreadsheet.

Suggested timeline: finalize MAP by 2028-12-02, run validation window 2028-12-03 — 2028-12-05, cutover decision 2028-12-07.

Next steps: please confirm owners for each item in the MAP_v1.xlsx and we will schedule the validation windows. If Novalabs wants stricter thresholds we can adapt — call it out in your reply.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Marta Ruiz <marta@novalabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 08:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — quick alignment on signals

Adding technical acceptance checks from Platform/Infra side. Quick notes — I'll own the load-validation runs and Laura will coordinate the security artifacts.

Technical acceptance tests to add to eval-testcases.csv:
- Cold-start variance: median P95 delta between warm and cold runs <= 20% (owner: karthik).
- KV cache hit rate >= 65% for prefix-heavy workloads (owner: Novalabs infra).
- Quantization sanity: end-to-end token accuracy drop <= 2% when using chosen quantized variant (owner: jonas / karthik).
- Error taxonomy: no more than 1% unknown-model-errors; all 5xxs must be investigated and logged with root cause (owner: Novalabs + Redwood on-call).

I'll spin up the validation cluster on 2028-12-02 and run two 1-hour windows on 12-03 and 12-04 per Jonas' timeline. Please attach the sample prompt set and the acceptance notebook to the Drive link when ready.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@novalabs.ai>

Thanks — this looks good and covers what the committee asked for. Two clarifications before we finalize:
1) For the Quality/Accuracy signal, can you provide the exact eval set (we maintain a private holdout) so we can run a mirror?
2) We need the fallback policy text put into the MAP spreadsheet under "Operational controls" — specifically, who triggers automatic fallback (threshold + owner).

If you can drop the eval set link and update the MAP_v1.xlsx by EOD PST today we will confirm owners and lock the timeline.

— Marta

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novalabs.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — quick alignment on signals

Got it — attaching updated MAP_v1.xlsx (Operational controls section completed) and a secure link to the eval set in the Drive doc.

Operational fallback (summary pasted into MAP):
- Trigger: automated monitoring detects P95 > 300ms for 5 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 3% for 3 consecutive minutes.
- Action: traffic shift to model-variant:small-quantized (automated) + page SRE (manual on-call).
- Owner: Redwood on-call (primary), Novalabs infra (secondary).

Eval set link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3ceval-set (access granted to your eval@novalabs.ai address).
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9341 — I updated the MAP artifact there as well.

We will run the validation windows as Karthik outlined on 12-03 and 12-04. If everything is green we will proceed to decision on 2028-12-07 per your committee schedule.

Attachments included: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-testcases.csv (test cases).

Thanks — looking forward to the runs.
Jonas
